steps.domain_action: The system begins in the Deep, the unmarked void before any distinction is made.
The First Sister raises the scissor, creating the initial distinction 𐑦 (if).
The interaction splits into two arms: the T-arm (affirmative binding) and the F-arm (refuted binding).
The T-arm evaluates the affirmative bind, enforcing the high kinetic barrier.
The T-arm chains the distinction with the topology, weaving the cut into a structure.
The F-arm evaluates the refuted bind, exploring the escape or symmetry restoration.
The F-arm descends, collapsing the distinction back toward the Deep.
The F-arm chains the descent with the topology, weaving the collapse into a structure.
The two arms rejoin, fusing the affirmative and refuted states into a single verdict.
The system holds the contradiction of binding and unbinding simultaneously, a live paradice.
The system recognizes itself, the weaver seeing their own face in the weave.
The integer winding invariant is recorded, fixing the topological class against perturbations.
The system closes, the Ouroboric Knot containing the entire bulk within a single register.
